messages.name: getDeviceState
messages.doc: Surface asks the Flutter shell for current BLE device state. Shell owns BLE lifecycle (see constraints-and-conventions.md).

messages.name: startListening
messages.doc: Surface commands the shell to open a capture session. Shell owns audio capture and the /listen socket.

messages.name: transcriptEvent
messages.doc: Shell pushes transcript segments to the surface. shellSentAtMs is set by the shell for latency measurement.
